attributes.action: A leadership challenge will bring no change to this current labour government.
attributes.additional_details:
A leadership change with the current government will bring no real change.
Let the British public decide with a general election. 
Andy Burnham words after winning the by election.
The course this country is heading needs to change.
I believe a new Labour Prime Minister won't bring the change so desperately needed.
We need to have the final voice, Call for a general election.
attributes.background:
I/we the general public believe a leadership challenge/change will bring no real change to the course this country is going under a Labour government full stop.
Give the people the choice and invoke a general election.
I/We the nation should have the right to who should govern next.

rejection.details:
You may wish to sign this petition:

General election now – and always call one if a PM is replaced
